title: Forward Precision and Round-Trip Test Campaign
negative_results: an unknown body is refused in CampaignConfig
an ico_depth with no declared tolerance is refused
ico_tolerance_m for an undeclared depth is refused
exact-boundary directions (pole/edge/vertex) are safely refused by the ico codec and counted, not treated as failures

claims.statement: Over a synthetic point grid (lattice + poles/dateline/Null-Island edge cases + seeded fuzz) across bodies and depths, map->vector->map round-trip error stays under the declared tolerance for CW-GEO-1 (sub-mm) and for the icosahedral codec (per-depth, per-body cell bound), and the icosahedral error decreases monotonically with refinement depth (POWER).
The campaign is deterministic: identical config yields identical measured maxima and point sets.
An invalid campaign configuration is a typed refusal.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic grid and seeded fuzz only, no wall-clock, no private inputs
